district_gang_barks: Wrong alley, champ. Turn it around.
Our block, our rules, our marble steps.
You lost, or just looking for trouble?
Pigeons got more sense than you, hon.
Back off before I call my cousin.
Nobody rolls through Fells without a nod.
Eyes up, the new kid's walking funny.
We seen your kind at the arabber cart.
Keep moving, or keep the bruises.
Whole rowhouse is watching you, pal.
Ain't no water taxi coming to save you.
Told ya, this corner bites back.
boss_defeat_lines: Fine! Keep the block. I'm keeping my dignity.
My crown... it was rented anyway.
Tell my mother I went down swinging, hon.
You got lucky. Real lucky. Annoyingly lucky.
I'll be back after a long nap and a sandwich.
That's it, I'm retiring to the county.
My whole gang saw that. I'm moving.
Not the beehive! Anything but the beehive!
Okay, okay, you win the harbor. Happy?
Ow. Ow. Okay, that one really stung.
Somebody hand me a towel and an ice pack.
Next time I'm bringing my big brother.
tutorial_tips: Tap jump twice near a wall to scramble up.
Hold the dash button to slide under parked cars.
Coins glow brighter when a combo is building.
Stoops are safe spots. Sit to refill your health.
Ride the water taxi to skip across the harbor.
Watch the boss wind up, then dodge to the side.
Arabber carts sell snacks that boost your speed.
Open the map to see which districts are cleared.
Gang barks warn you a fight is about to start.
Pause anytime to swap gear without losing progress.
pause_menu_subtitles: Grab a snack. We'll hold the block.
